framework: Python stdlib + pandas + OpenAI Python SDK; Coordinator uses manual dependency injection per architecture.md
runtime: local orchestration with OpenAI API inference

coordinator.usage: one audit-rationale API call per case; cannot change deterministic output

payment.model: none (rule-based reconciliation over order_payments CSV via pandas, no LLM call)

delivery_policy.model: none (rule-based EC_POLICY_V1 application, no LLM call)

verifier.model: none (rule-based schema/consistency validation, no LLM call)
